plugins.generateNotesCmd: if [ '${lastRelease.version}' = '1.4.0' ]; then printf '%s\n' '## Android signing migration' '' 'If your current APK is signed with the former test key (including v1.3.0 and v1.4.0), follow the [migration prerelease instructions](https://github.com/jeffusion/Termix/releases/tag/migration-v1.4.0) before using the regular APK.'; fi
plugins.prepareCmd: env -u GITHUB_TOKEN TERMIX_OFFICIAL_RELEASE=true bash -c 'bash scripts/bump-version.sh ${nextRelease.version} && ./gradlew app:lintDebug testDebugUnitTest assembleRelease && bash scripts/prepare-release-apk.sh ${nextRelease.version}'
